mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months signals a shift toward monetary easing, lowering discount rates and increasing present-value weights on future cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of macro-easing episodes despite the signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a sudden tightening cycle, raising discount rates and compressing the present value of expected equity cash flows, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of tightening episodes despite the signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day forward returns in > 60% of strong-labor episodes despite the signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 6-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below 100,000 jobs signals a weakening labor market, which raises uncertainty about corporate earnings and consumer demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of weak-labor episodes despite the signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 100.0 signals rising supply capacity and robust domestic demand, which compresses discount rates and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of high-supply episodes despite the signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 signals supply-side contraction and weak domestic demand, which raises discount rates and compresses the present value of expected equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of low-supply episodes despite the signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 6-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in retail sales (HOUST) above 1,500 units signals resilient consumer demand, which lowers discount rates and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of high-demand episodes despite the signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in retail sales (HOUST) below 1,500 units signals weak consumer demand and supply-side constraints, which raises discount rates and compresses the present value of expected equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of low-demand episodes despite the signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
